## Evidence and capability boundaries

- This release is not a Full Living Reference.
- Dataviz fundamentals use synthetic training fixture DV-FIXTURE-0.1. Nine additional cards use source-limited, product-specific CityMETER public snapshots or explicitly labelled treatment sketches under CITYMETER-DV-SNAPSHOT-2026-07-29.
- Product data, methods, claims, terminology, thresholds, and capabilities remain product-specific.
- Locale Insight spans Land, Location, and Living at portfolio, methodology, and product-architecture levels without merging product evidence boundaries.
- Cross-product or cross-city comparison requires the same compatible schema and release, or a visible incompatibility explanation.
- Root, standalone, Complete Color Atlas, Site Manifest, and Build Card must resolve Color Set `color-srgb-03` and the prepared UI artifact build `ui-20260820-01`. Any governed color, gradient, token-source, or scale-source change requires a new Color Set ID. A UI-only change keeps the Color Set ID but mints a new append-only artifact-build ID and immutable filename. After publication and exact-byte verification, the current immutable UI artifact—not a cacheable latest alias—is the visual-review and handoff authority.
- The playground does not save, share, invite, publish, track, or mutate a remote governed object.
- Contextual discovery offers two explicit user-triggered destinations from the same visible editable public-safe query: Google Search for a source trail, or Google AI Mode for synthesis and follow-up. The provider route is an implementation detail. Four current public CityMETER record snapshots may compose the query; the incident endpoint exposes no provenance, values with unresolved scope are omitted, and both Search results and AI synthesis remain `discovery_only` until cited sources are opened, checked, and deliberately incorporated with provenance.
- No bounded agent action is enabled. Machine-readable files are reference inputs, not permission to act.

## Machine-use rules

- Preserve object ID, version, scope, boundary, time, source, missingness, confidence, limitation, allowed use, visibility, and authoritative state.
- Never upgrade partial to complete, modelled to observed, planned to available, sent to received, handoff to network effect, or discovery to evidence.
- Do not universalize CityMETER, CityWiki, CityChat, ijji, municipality, retail, F&B, flood, land-valuation, or other product-instance assumptions.
- Do not make or execute consequential decisions affecting rights, access, eligibility, housing, health, safety, employment, credit, or public benefit.
- Do not infer an agent action endpoint from a human-facing link or control.

This project-path llms.txt follows an emerging convention and is a navigation aid only. It is not the host-root llms.txt for montri-th.github.io, a crawler directive, a ranking signal, an access-control rule, or permission for an agent to act, and it is not guaranteed to be discovered by search engines or AI systems.
